text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahh! Captain Golshi is back and ready for action!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A voyage to the hidden lands beyond the seven seas was just what I needed to recharge my batteries!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's too bad you weren't there to see the sun set over the Great Golshi Ocean!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The location of the Great Golshi Ocean may forever remain a mystery, but at least Gold Ship seems fully refreshed.
